name: Materialise Profile
description: The parameter values a Profile sets are values the parameters allow. The check changes nothing; the unravel step writes the rows.

conditions.statement: Every parameter value set on the Profile is allowed by the parameter before the Profile moves from Draft to Validated.

requiredEvidence.title: Profile Materialisation Check Record
requiredEvidence.description: The result of the materialisation check run when the Profile is validated.
